text:
maria: heads-up from partner SentinelWorks: they're seeing a ~ $14k divergence between their reported entitlements and our marketplace billing. They say seats in certain SKUs are being double-counted when customers migrate plans mid-cycle. tagging partners/ops.

keith: thanks. initial hypothesis: SKU mapping mismatch combined with our entitlement stitch that runs in the middle of invoice windows. if a customer upgrades from sku:starter -> sku:pro, our stitch might attribute overlapping seat counts to both SKUs for the same hour.

jon: do we have an example account id to repro? this sounds like a left-join vs replace semantics bug in entitlement rollup.

maria: sent two sample accounts to the thread (internal link). sentinel connector sends plan_change events + periodic entitlement snapshots. the plan_change sometimes arrives out-of-order relative to the snapshot because of their SI integration retries.

tara: are plan_change events idempotent or do they carry a version? if they have a version we can enforce monotonic application.

keith: sentinel plan_change has change_id but older SI proxies drop header in retries. our stitch logic currently applies snapshots then applies plan_change patches by event_ts; with reordering we can temporarily reflect both plans. impact: invoice window shows both starter and pro active seats for overlapping hours.

maria: customer-visible impact = inflated seat count, potential partner refund request. we need a short-term guard and a long-term fix.

jon: short-term mitigation: when we detect overlapping entitlements for same user_id and overlapping windows, prefer the record with latest commit_seq if present, otherwise prefer snapshot over incremental change within a 2h reordering window. Also surface overlap alerts to partnerships channel.

keith: long-term: change entitlement stitch to be replace semantics for hourly windows when snapshot or plan_change with version present. add tombstone markers for replaced ranges: tombstone_key=(partner_id, customer_id, window_start, replacement_seq). Stitch should ignore incrementals older than tombstone replacement_seq.

tara: i'll work with Sentinel SI to ensure change_id/version is propagated in all retries; partnerships to request they enable v2 entitlements in next deploy.

recon-bot: created ticket PRJ-8122 "sentinel-entitlement-stitch-replace-semantics" assigned to @keith. (https://redwood.atlassian.com/PRJ-8122) :robot_face:

jon: playbook sketch:
- run a dry-run stitch for impacted invoice periods to compute per-customer delta and highlight overlapping hours
- produce a CSV of affected customers + suggested adjustments for partner review
- after partner sign-off apply compensating ledger adjustments via ledger-service (PATCH /partners/:id/entitlements/adjust) which records compensating entries rather than destructive edits
- emit audit trail and notify billing/legal for invoice reissue window

keith: sampling estimate from a 90d run: ~4.2k overlapping hour-windows across 310 customers; estimated ledger delta ~$14k. compute job ~0.25 batch-hours.

maria: owners + ETAs:
- keith: PR to add tombstone keys + replace-semantics in entitlement stitch + dry-run job (ETA 3 days)
- jon: generate CSV for partner + unit tests for replace precedence (ETA 2 days)
- tara: coordinate with Sentinel SI to ensure change_id propagation and request v2 rollout (ETA 1 day)

jon: add alert: if percent overlap > 0.2% for any partner in 24h, block auto-apply and page partnerships oncall.

tara: i'll also draft partner comms and legal approval flow; we can offer a one-time cleanup reconcile if they enable v2 within 2 weeks.

maria: scheduling a sync with SentinelWorks tomorrow 9am PT to walk through the plan. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
